retired.question: What special themed night on Disney cruises features costumes, deck parties, and fireworks at sea?

retained.question: What is the name of the fireworks show that Disney launches from their ships at sea on Pirate Night?

rationale: 434 explicitly supplies Pirate Night as the fireworks occasion while asking the fireworks-show name. Retain that additional show fact rather than the broad event identity.

sources.locator: Title; Party Like a Pirate; fireworks image captions
sources.evidence: Pirate Night is the costume-and-deck-party event on select itineraries with fireworks imagery; it is not guaranteed on every sailing.
sources.limitations: Primary institutional text inspected; no film or video viewing claimed.

originalOptionAssessments.assessment: Pirate Night is the named costume/deck-party occasion.
Princess Night is not that official event title.
Superhero Night is not that official pirate-themed event title.
Adventure Night is not that official event title.
